SF_C1.label: Within the cap
SF_C1.plain: Of verified meetings, the share within the community's first three on its step — the meetings the pilot pays for; the rest are recorded and unpaid.

SF_D1.label: Repeat counts
SF_D1.plain: Of verified meetings, the share whose attendance counts exactly repeat the previous meeting's — a review flag, not a rejection.

SF_D2.label: Location flags
SF_D2.plain: Of meeting records, the share whose location was missing, worse than 50 m, or more than 2 km from the community — reviewed, never a payment condition.

SF_D3.label: One-meeting steps
SF_D3.plain: Of the steps communities completed, the share marked complete at the step's first meeting — a review flag, since a step usually takes about two meetings.

SF_P1.label: Meeting regularity
SF_P1.plain: Of the weeks since each community enrolled (7-day weeks counted from its enrolment date), the share with at least one verified community meeting.

SF_P3.label: Step 7 on time
SF_P3.plain: Of enrolled communities whose 15 weeks since enrolment have run out (or that already finished Step 7), the share that completed Step 7 within 15 weeks. Reported, not paid on.

SF_S1.label: Household attendance
SF_S1.plain: Households represented at verified meetings, out of the community's enrolled households.

SF_S2.label: Women attending
SF_S2.plain: Of everyone attending verified meetings, the share who were women.

SF_S3.label: Spoke up
SF_S3.plain: Of everyone attending verified meetings, the share who spoke.

SF_S4.label: Women who spoke
SF_S4.plain: Of the women attending verified meetings, the share who spoke.

SF_S5.label: Saving
SF_S5.plain: Of communities on Step 5 or later, the share whose latest meeting reported the community is saving.
